description: Guilds: leave. WHEN: leave your guild. Leaving with an active rookie contract BREACHES it: the escrowed signing bonus is forfeited to the treasury and you take a reputation hit. A Guildmaster with other members must transfer/disband first (v1: cannot leave); a lone Guildmaster leaving disbands the guild. Starts your 24h rejoin cooldown. Example: guild_leave {"guild_id":"<guild_id>"}
